blurb: Guests rent jet skis or pontoon boats to explore Ocean City Maryland's bay and Assateague Island National Seashore. Jet ski rentals include a 6-mile open water route with wild horses, dolphins, and sandbars. Pontoon boats are private rentals allowing guests to captain their own boat and beach on Assateague's bay-side sandbars.
extraNote: All sales are final; no refunds · Cancellations by operator due to weather or mechanical issues get full credit · Pontoon reservations are phone-only; no online booking · Late arrival reduces water time · 12817 Harbor Rd, Ocean City MD, right on the bay with direct water access
